title: Operating System 9 and Audio Usability
summary: Feedback on the infotainment system centers on ease of use for Operating System 9 and the media/audio system, with both praise for simplicity and complaints about slow response, touchscreen-only control, and disappointment, while many fragments are too brief or unclear to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive feedback says Operating System 9 is excellent and simple to use.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on a slow-reacting audio system, dislike of the touchscreen-only operating system, and general disappointment with the media system.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention the audio or media system, CarPlay compatibility, startup behavior, and getting used to the operating system, but the sample often lacks enough context for a clear sentiment label.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are very short or incomplete, which limits confident interpretation of sentiment.
The undetermined group includes both seemingly favorable and unfavorable wording, so its content should not be treated as a clear sentiment pattern.
The sample is small and sentiment-stratified, so it does not support broader claims beyond these excerpts.
